episodes.title: Hanako del doposcuola. L'ambizione dei Mokke
episodes.synopsis: Nene is fed up with cleaning bathrooms, but there's no getting out of her ghostly bargain, so she seeks advice to make her chores fun. Later, the mokke attack Hanako, hoping to take his place as a Wonder. But why?
